subject: general
question: India is ranked at the ________ place in the ‘Climate Change Performance Index (CCPI) 2021’, which was released on 7 December 2020.
solution:
The correct answer is __**10th.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• In the 'Climate Change Performance Index (CCPI) 2021,' published on 7 December 2020, India is ranked 10th. India's total score is 63.98.
 
• For the second time in a row, from among the 58 economies, India emerged among the top 10 countries with higher climate results.
 
• India was in ninth position in the index last year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first three positions in the 2021 list, including CCPI 2020, still remain unoccupied, as none of the countries are on the road consistent with the Paris climate goals to adopt policies to minimize global warming below 2 or even 1.5 °C.
 
• In the table, Sweden (4th), the United Kingdom (5th), Denmark (6th), Morocco (7th), Norway (8th), Chile (9th) were among the top 10.
 
• It was also noted that only the EU as a whole, along with the UK and India, ranked among the high-performing G20 countries.
